name: quest.site/sitequest-hosting
title: Sitequest Hosting
description: VPS, webspaces, domains and DNS in EU datacenters. Sign in with OAuth or use an API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. API key from the Sitequest dashboard (API / MCP), sent as a Bearer token. Clients that support MCP authorization sign in with OAuth instead and need no key.

api_key.description: API key with the sq_live_ prefix. Its scopes decide which tools are listed.
